note: The same document as test.txt.sig with its two header lines stored in the other order. WriteHeader sorts on output, so test.txt.sig is the canonical order and new_test.txt.sig is the reverse. Header order carries no meaning, so it must verify, and inspect sorts what it reads so it must report identically.

cases.name: Inspect Header Order Reversed
cases.note: Reported identically to the canonical document, which is the whole point of sorting on output.

cases.name: Sign Header Order Reversed
cases.note: Re-signing normalizes the order, so the reversed document signs back to the canonical one byte for byte.
